    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    Board
    Represents the board of Jungle King consisting of multiple tiles, where each represents a different animal piece or special tile.
    CardSelectionController
    Represents the controller architecture of the card selection process of players
    CardSelectionGUI
    Represents the graphical user interface (view) of the card selection process of the players
    CardSelectionLogic
    Represents the model of the card selection process of players
    Cat
    Represents the cat animal piece in the game with its corresponding strengths, extending the Piece class.
    Dog
    Represents the dog animal piece in the game with its corresponding strengths, extending the Piece class.
    Elephant
    Represents the elephant animal piece in the game with its corresponding strengths, extending the Piece class.
    GameGUI
    Represents the graphical user interface (view) of the Jungle King game board
    HomePageGUI
    Represents the graphical user interface of the homepage
    JungleKingController
    Represents the controller of the Jungle King game
    Leopard
    Represents the leopard animal piece in the game with its corresponding strengths, extending the Piece class.
    Lion
    Represents a Lion piece in the game, as it can cross the lakes in the board This class extends the Piece class
    Piece
    Represents an animal piece and its corresponding name and strength These pieces are moved around the board and can capture another player's pieces
    Player
    Represents a player in the game A player has a name and its own pieces to move around the board
    PlayerSetupGUI
    Represents the graphical user interface of the player setup process
    Rat
    Represents a rat piece in the game, as it can swim in the lakes in the board This class extends the Piece class
    RuleFrameGUI
    Represents the graphical user interface of the rules of the game
    Tiger
    Represents a tiger piece in the game, as it can cross the lakes in the board This class extends the Piece class
    Tile
    Represents a tile on the board It can either contain a piece, a trap, a homebase, a lake, or be empty.
    WinnerGUI
    Represents the graphical user interface displaying the winner of the game and the option to play again or exit game
    Wolf
    Represents the wolf animal piece in the game with its corresponding strengths, extending the Piece class.
